title: Plus Therapeutics, Inc. 8-K Filing — Appointment of Chief Development Officer
summary: Plus Therapeutics, Inc. (PSTV), a small-cap biotech company listed on Nasdaq Capital Market, filed an 8-K on April 8-9, 2026 disclosing the appointment of Dr. Eric J. Daniels as Chief Development Officer, effective April 20, 2026. Dr. Daniels' compensation package includes a $460,000 annual base salary, 40% target bonus, 20,000 stock options, and 20,000 restricted stock units. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Plus Therapeutics appointed Dr. Eric J. Daniels, age 53, as Chief Development Officer effective April 20, 2026
Dr. Daniels' annual base salary is $460,000 with a 40% target bonus
Dr. Daniels receives 20,000 stock options and 20,000 RSUs as sign-on equity awards
Involuntary termination severance includes 12 months base salary plus target bonus plus 12 months COBRA premiums
Dr. Daniels previously served as CDO at Kiora Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:KPRX) from October 2021 through April 2026
Company is incorporated in Delaware, trading on Nasdaq Capital Market under symbol PSTV
